parameters.content:
## Part A: Intake
Someone mentions **@icp-bot** with a LinkedIn link.
Known person → lead card in the thread. New person → saved in Supabase, sent to Clay.

## Part B: Clay results
Clay's HTTP API column posts the enriched person here.
Saved to Supabase → the same lead card is posted in the lead's thread.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.channel, thread_ts: $json.thread_ts, text: "That doesn't look like a LinkedIn profile link. Try: https://www.linkedin.com/in/username" }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ linkedin_url: $('Clean URL').first().json.linkedin_url, sdr_slack_id: $('Clean URL').first().json.sdr_slack_id, slack_channel_id: $('Clean URL').first().json.channel, slack_thread_ts: $('Clean URL').first().json.thread_ts, status: 'received' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Clean URL').first().json.channel, thread_ts: $('Clean URL').first().json.thread_ts, text: `:mag: Enriching ${$('Clean URL').first().json.linkedin_url}, the lead card will appear here in a couple of minutes.`, unfurl_links: false }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('Supabase: create lead').first().json.id, linkedin_url: $('Clean URL').first().json.linkedin_url }) }}
